status_ceiling_note: No component in this package exceeds LOCALLY_PROVEN. DNS is capped at LOCALLY_EXECUTED and the production signer remains DEFINED.

components.name: canonical
components.purpose: Deterministic JSON serialization and SHA-256 hashing used by every other component so that identical logical objects always hash identically.
components.conceptual_validation: Argue key-order independence and byte stability from the JSON dump parameters (sort_keys, tight separators, ensure_ascii).
components.practical_validation: pytest assertions that reordered dicts serialize and hash identically and that digests are 64 hex chars.
limitations: Non-JSON-native values are coerced via str() and are therefore lossy.

components.name: linguistic_core
components.purpose: Normalise free text and map it deterministically onto a closed set of runtime intents; the only component permitted to read raw text.
components.conceptual_validation: Show the mapping is a pure function of (lexicon version, normalised tokens) with no clock, randomness or I/O.
components.practical_validation: pytest coverage of normalisation, tokenisation, all five intents, UNKNOWN fallback, token validation bounds and ValueError guards.
limitations: No syntax, negation or multi-clause handling.

components.name: identity
components.purpose: Derive collision-resistant identities for components, skills and services and refuse to let one identity denote two different input tuples.
components.conceptual_validation: Identity is SHA-256 over a canonical tuple; collision resistance reduces to SHA-256 preimage/collision resistance.
components.practical_validation: pytest determinism, distinctness, collision detection and CollisionError-on-conflict tests.
limitations: Registry is in-memory only and is not persisted across processes.

components.name: ledger
components.purpose: Append-only SQLite event log whose entries form a SHA-256 hash chain, giving tamper evidence and restart continuity.
components.conceptual_validation: Each entry hash covers the previous hash, so any mutation invalidates every subsequent link.
components.practical_validation: pytest appends, reopen-continues-chain, direct SQL corruption of payload and of entry_hash, both detected.
limitations: Tamper evidence, not tamper prevention: a writer with DB access can rewrite the whole chain unless the root hash is externally anchored.
No external anchoring is performed in this package.

components.name: signer
components.purpose: Provide a proven local signing path (HMAC over the canonical payload) and an explicitly unimplemented production signing boundary.
components.conceptual_validation: Signing over canonical bytes means semantically identical payloads verify and any mutation fails; the production path is intentionally fail-closed.
components.practical_validation: pytest sign/verify round trip, tampered payload, tampered signature, wrong key, NotImplementedError assertions.
limitations: TestSigner uses a published symmetric key and provides no non-repudiation.
ProductionSignerPlaceholder is DEFINED only and cannot become PRODUCTION_VALIDATED without real KMS/HSM key infrastructure.

components.name: dns_transport
components.purpose: Build and parse DNS messages on the wire and query resolvers over UDP with TCP fallback, emitting honestly capped proof receipts.
components.conceptual_validation: Header, question and answer encodings are checked against RFC 1035 field layout including label compression pointers.
components.practical_validation: pytest byte-level header assertions plus parsing of synthetic A, TXT, multi-answer and CNAME responses through a mocked socket; live failure path exercised against TEST-NET-3.
limitations: Authoritative external DNS confirmation is NOT possible from the sandbox; status is capped at LOCALLY_EXECUTED.

components.name: restart
components.purpose: Persist a restart marker, simulate unclean shutdown and prove that the ledger chain survives process death intact.
components.conceptual_validation: Recovery compares the persisted head hash against the recomputed chain head, so silent divergence is impossible.
components.practical_validation: pytest save/load round trip, crash simulation, reopen-and-verify, continuity_proven assertions.
limitations: Restart is simulated in-process; no OS-level kill -9 or power-loss test is performed.
Marker file is not itself signed.

components.name: runtime
components.purpose: Orchestrate every subsystem into one lifecycle: start, process commands, report status, shut down cleanly and resume.
components.conceptual_validation: Every externally visible action produces exactly one ledger entry, so the ledger is a complete trace of the session.
components.practical_validation: pytest end-to-end lifecycle, malformed command handling, restart-and-resume with chain verification.
limitations: No network listener and no authentication of the caller.

components.name: receipts
components.purpose: Turn execution outcomes into durable evidence artefacts: package manifests, test result records and validation receipts.
components.conceptual_validation: Manifest hashing is a pure function of file bytes, so any file edit changes the manifest hash.
components.practical_validation: pytest manifest over a temp tree, stability across repeated runs, PASSED/FAILED status logic, argument guards.
limitations: Manifest excludes caches and compiled artefacts.
